description: This file contains functions related to upgrading firmware images on SD cards, specifically for legacy systems. It includes procedures for checking image compatibility, performing the upgrade, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the SD card image has the same partition layout as the existing device, to decide if a full upgrade is necessary.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade on the SD card, including writing the bootloader and partition images, handling different strategies based on the provided options.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from the backup location to the boot partition of the SD card.
